name: Thunderblast Slippers (Greater)
text:
Unassuming in appearance, these slippers indicate their nature only with a signature strip of yellow stitching. You gain a +2 item bonus to Acrobatics checks.

---
Activate 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You move like the wind, with precision and speed. You Stride up to 120 feet; this movement doesn't trigger reactions. When you stop, if you've moved at least 30 feet from where you started, you release a thunderous 5-foot emanation that deals 3d6 bludgeoning damage and 3d6 sonic damage with a DC 34 basic Fortitude save. A creature that critically fails its save is also knocked Prone.
